gatoh.agents.Agent.evolve_hierarchies

Agent.evolve_hierarchies(rw_distributions: dict[str, tuple[float, float]]) → None[source]

Experimental function that aims to model the constantly evolving ‘intrinsic value’ that Agents place on the social hierarchies that they belong in over time.

Parameters:

rw_distributions (dict[str, tuple[float, float]]) – A mapping specifying the global random walk distributions defined for each hierarchy in the model.

Raises:

  • TypeError – If the input parameter contains an invalid data type.

  • KeyError – If a non-existent hierarchy key is passed in the input dictionary.
